info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Reminders-v4-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Reminder Retrieval API allows users to access a list of utility billing reminders efficiently. This endpoint provides key information related to upcoming billing reminders to ensure timely payments and enhance user experience. Typically utilized by finance departments or billing systems, this API supports use cases such as monitoring deadlines, generating reports, and improving collections. By offering easy retrieval of essential reminders, businesses can better manage their billing processes and maintain positive customer relationships.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details about their billing reminders, including amounts due and payment deadlines. It is crucial for managing subscriptions and timely payments.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve billing reminder information related to a specific user or service. It requires parameters that define the context for the reminder, such as user identification or service specifics.

ListUtilityBillingRemindersRequest.description: This schema defines the request body for the GET operation related to billing reminders in the application.

ListUtilityBillingRemindersResponse_201.title: Billing Reminder Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the billing reminder operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Descriptive message related to the operation.

ListUtilityBillingRemindersResponse_201.description: Response object containing information about the billing reminder operation.
